notes.title: Pesky Humans Live Stream Demonstration
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Pesky Humans is an easy-to-learn but difficult to master "Reverse Space Invaders" where those humans are trying to colonize your planet!  At 8PM on February 8th, I will be giving a quick preview of the overall gameplay and, as possible, answering questions via the live stream.

This will be our first live stream, so hopefully everything goes off without a hitch.  Look forward to seeing you all then!
